abilities.name: Bound by the Khala
abilities.text: Use when the Current Supply Value of another Friendly Unit Within 8″ of this Unit is reduced. Return one Non-Unique Exhausted Tactical Card to the Ready state.

abilities.name: Psionic Gale
abilities.text: Set a Psionic Storm token Within 10″ and Line of Sight of this Unit. This token is not removed if this Unit is Destroyed. At the End of each Phase, set a Psionic Storm Blast Template on the centre of this token. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 3 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. For each result of 4+, that Unit suffers an effect depending on the current Phase: Movement Phase: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1). Assault Phase: 1 Damage. If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase, resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.

abilities.name: Feedback
abilities.text: Target one Enemy Mechanical or Psionic Unit Within 8″. Until the End of the Round, after that Unit resolves an Active or Reaction Special Ability (excluding abilities granted by a Tactical Card or Faction Card), it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (3).
